Input/Output: Mercator map
Requirement Description: The sim shall show a Mercator map of the parent in body-fixed coordinates, with pan and zoom. Earth uses Natural Earth coastlines stored in the page.
Acceptance Criteria: Satellite position on the map matches lat/lon computed from plan.csv within 0.01 deg.
Comments: Mercator: the standard flat world map projection. No map server is used, so it works offline.

Input/Output: solid past, dashed future
Requirement Description: The sim shall draw each satellite's ground trace on the map, with the past solid and the track ahead dashed.
Acceptance Criteria: Trace passes through the satellite's lat/lon at every output step.
Comments: Ground trace: the line on the surface directly under the satellite.

Input/Output: Sun direction, day/night
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall show the Sun direction on the globe, light the globe from it, and show the night side and subsolar point on the map. Display only.
Acceptance Criteria: Subsolar point within 0.1 deg of ERFA.
Comments: Subsolar point: the spot on Earth with the Sun directly overhead. Uses a low-precision Sun formula, not DE440. Measured 0.01 deg from ERFA.

Input/Output: altitude, speed, lat/lon, a, e, i, LTAN, beta, sunlit or in eclipse, air density, abs(B)
Requirement Description: The sim shall show live readouts for the selected satellite.
Acceptance Criteria: Values match plan.csv and the SIM_003 models at the displayed epoch.

Input/Output: error list
Requirement Description: The sim shall check the whole config before running and list every invalid field by name.
Acceptance Criteria: Config with 5 known errors reports all 5 in one run.

Input/Output: example configs
Requirement Description: The sim shall offer built-in example configs covering Earth LEO, LTAN drift, a Walker constellation, mixed orbits, a small body, and drag with re-boost burns.
Acceptance Criteria: Each preset runs without error.

Input/Output: period (s), perigee and apogee altitude (m) per satellite
Requirement Description: The sim shall report period, perigee altitude and apogee altitude per satellite at start_epoch, in the run report and the plan.csv header.
Acceptance Criteria: Matches values computed from SIM_019 elements within 1e-9 relative.
Comments: Perigee/apogee: lowest and highest points of the orbit. Altitudes are above the equatorial radius.

Input/Output: LTAN at start and end (hh:mm:ss); drift (min/day) from a straight-line fit over the run
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall report each satellite's LTAN at start_epoch and its drift over the run.
Acceptance Criteria: SSO designed for 10:30 LTAN reads 10:30 within 1 min; plane-based LTAN matches local time at each northbound equator crossing within 1 s.
Comments: LTAN: mean local solar time when the satellite crosses the equator going north. Node measured on the true equator of date.

Input/Output: beta (deg) per output step; chart tab; drift (deg/day)
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall compute and chart the beta angle per satellite at every output step.
Acceptance Criteria: Beta is 0 within 0.1 deg for an orbit plane containing the Sun direction.
Comments: Beta angle: angle between the Sun and the orbit plane. Sets eclipse length and thermal and power loads.

Input/Output: in_shadow column in plan.csv; eclipse entry, exit and duration per orbit; chart tab
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall flag when each satellite is in Earth's cylindrical shadow, list eclipse events, and chart eclipse duration per orbit.
Acceptance Criteria: 550 km circular orbit at beta 0 gives eclipse duration within 5 s of the analytic value.
Comments: Simple version of SIM_063/SIM_064 using the built-in Sun. Cylindrical shadow: Earth's shadow as a straight tube, no penumbra. Measured 1.1 s from analytic.

Input/Output: name, lat (deg), lon (deg), alt (m), min elevation (deg)
Requirement Description: The sim shall accept a list of ground stations and compute access windows to each satellite.
Acceptance Criteria: AOS and LOS times match a reference pass within one output step.
Comments: AOS/LOS: acquisition and loss of signal, when the satellite rises above and sets below the station's minimum elevation.

Input/Output: station markers, access table
Requirement Description: The sim shall show ground stations on the map and globe and list access windows with start, end, duration and max elevation.
Acceptance Criteria: Every window in the table appears as a highlighted arc on the ground trace.

Input/Output: half-angle field of view (deg) or swath width (km); off-nadir angle (deg)
Requirement Description: The sim shall draw each satellite's sensor footprint and swath on the map.
Acceptance Criteria: Nadir swath width at 550 km matches spherical-Earth geometry within 1%.
Comments: Swath: the strip of ground the sensor covers as the satellite passes. Off-nadir: tilt away from straight down.

Input/Output: name, lat (deg), lon (deg)
Requirement Description: The sim shall list every time a target falls inside a satellite's swath, and the revisit interval between passes.
Acceptance Criteria: Target placed on the ground trace is reported within one output step.
Comments: Revisit: time between successive passes over the same point.

Input/Output: ground trace as KML and CSV
Requirement Description: The sim shall export each satellite's ground trace as KML and as a lat/lon/alt CSV.
Acceptance Criteria: KML opens in Google Earth with tracks over the right places.
Comments: KML: the file format Google Earth reads.

Input/Output: URL with config encoded
Requirement Description: The sim shall produce a link that opens the page with the current config loaded.
Acceptance Criteria: Opening the link reproduces plan.csv exactly.

Input/Output: altitude vs time, per satellite
Requirement Description: The sim shall show an altitude vs time plot in the page.
Acceptance Criteria: Plotted values match plan.csv geodetic altitude.
Comments: Covered by SIM_096.

Input/Output: drag on/off; Cd, area (m^2), shared or per satellite
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall apply atmospheric drag using the exponential atmosphere, co-rotating with Earth, and the satellite mass.
Acceptance Criteria: Energy lost over a 1-day 300 km run equals integrated drag work within 1%.
Comments: First step of SIM_026/SIM_027. Measured ratio 1.000003. The atmosphere has no solar-activity input, so decay rates are indicative only.

Input/Output: point | J2 | J2-J4
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall let the user choose how many zonal gravity terms to include.
Acceptance Criteria: J2-only RAAN drift matches the analytic J2 formula within 0.5%.
Comments: Useful for comparing against textbook results and other tools.

Input/Output: LTAN vs elapsed time, per satellite
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall chart LTAN over the run for every satellite, with a cursor at the playback time and the drift rate per satellite.
Acceptance Criteria: Charted values match SIM_083 at every output step; drift shown matches the plan.csv header.
Comments: Use a run of at least 1 day for a clean drift rate.

Input/Output: altitude vs elapsed time, per satellite; instantaneous and one-orbit average; drift (m/day)
Requirement Description: The sim shall chart each satellite's altitude over the run, with a one-orbit average and a drift rate from a straight-line fit of that average.
Acceptance Criteria: Circular orbit around sphere_uniform reads constant altitude a - R; drift is shown only for runs of at least 3 orbits and 12 h.
Comments: One-orbit average removes the once-per-orbit swing from eccentricity and Earth's bulge, so the drift rate shows real change such as drag decay.

Input/Output: 1 orbit | 6 h | 24 h | whole run
Requirement Description: The sim shall fade each satellite's past trace over a user-selected trail length on the map and globe, and limit the dashed preview ahead to the same length.
Acceptance Criteria: No trace older than the trail length is drawn; the choice is remembered between visits.
Comments: Keeps long runs readable. Default 24 h.

Input/Output: CSV per chart tab
Requirement Description: The sim shall export the data of the current chart tab as CSV.
Acceptance Criteria: Exported values match the plotted values; every row carries satellite name, t (s) and UTC epoch.
Comments: Files: ltan.csv, alt.csv, beta.csv, ecl.csv, range.csv.

Input/Output: range (m) and line of sight from the selected satellite to every other satellite
Requirement Description: The sim shall chart the distance from the selected satellite to every other satellite over the run, mark where the parent blocks the line of sight, and report the closest approach.
Acceptance Criteria: Range matches distance computed from plan.csv positions within 1 mm.
Comments: Partial SIM_042/SIM_048: one reference satellite at a time, no close-approach alarm threshold.

Input/Output: two-line element set as an orbit entry
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall accept a TLE as a satellite's initial orbit, converted to an inertial state at start_epoch.
Acceptance Criteria: Position within 25 km of SGP4 for low orbits at the TLE epoch and one day later; bad checksum is rejected.
Comments: TLE: the standard published orbit format. Approximate, because TLEs hold averaged elements. Measured 8 to 16 km in LEO, 56 km for a Molniya orbit.

Input/Output: fields and dropdowns for parent, time, forces, satellites, patterns and burns
Requirement Description: The sim shall provide a form for the common settings that stays in sync with the JSON config in both directions.
Acceptance Criteria: Every form edit appears in the JSON; loading a config or example fills the form.
Comments: The JSON config stays the single source of truth (SIM_055). State-vector and TLE orbits are listed in the form but edited in the JSON.

Input/Output: 3D globe, Mercator map, LTAN drift, Altitude drift, Beta angle, Eclipse, Range
Requirement Description: The sim shall let the user switch between views with tabs and remember the last tab used.
Acceptance Criteria: Each tab renders for every preset without error.

Input/Output: epoch, body-fixed position, satellite name
Requirement Description: With drag on, the sim shall stop a satellite that falls to 80 km altitude, continue the others, and report a re-entry event.
Acceptance Criteria: A 125 km orbit ends in a re-entry event; other satellites are unaffected.
Comments: Below 80 km the fixed-step integrator and simple atmosphere are not valid, so the run stops there instead of at the surface.

Input/Output: energy drift after removing drag work and burn energy
Requirement Description: When drag or burns are present, the sim shall report the energy drift left after subtracting drag work and burn energy.
Acceptance Criteria: Residual below 1e-8 relative over a 1-day run with drag and burns.
Comments: Extends SIM_044 so the numerical health check still works when energy is not conserved. Measured 1.1e-9 with drag.

Input/Output: darkened trace in shadow
Requirement Description: For earth_default, the sim shall darken the part of each trace flown in Earth's shadow on the map and globe.
Acceptance Criteria: Shaded parts match the in_shadow column in plan.csv.

Input/Output: mass_kg, cd, area_m2 on an orbit entry
Requirement Description: The sim shall let each satellite override the shared mass, drag coefficient and area.
Acceptance Criteria: 4x the area gives about 4x the drag work.
Comments: Partial SIM_027. Measured 4.3x, a little over 4 because the satellite sinks into denser air.

Input/Output: burn count and total delta-v per satellite; burn markers on charts
Requirement Description: The sim shall report the number of burns and total delta-v per satellite, and mark burn times on the charts.
Acceptance Criteria: Reported total equals the sum of the commanded delta-v magnitudes.
Comments: Partial SIM_050: delta-v only, no propellant mass.
